page.overview:
Who is Darkwing II?

Black Samson Dupli-Kate Shapesmith The Immortal Cecil Stedman Invincible

Benjamin Taylor, formerly known as Nightboy, is supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 to 3. Initially serving as a minor antagonist since his debut, he begins to redeem himself in Season 3 and onward. He is the original Darkwing's protégé. Following his mentor's death, Benjamin inherited the Darkwing mantle and attempted to continue his predecessor's crusade against crime.

However, unlike the original Darkwing, Benjamin's methods became dramatically more violent. His paranoia, distrust, and willingness to murder anyone he perceived as a criminal eventually pushed him into a psychological breakdown. He became increasingly delusional, developing a distorted perception of himself as a heroic figure despite committing numerous atrocities.

His encounter with Invincible ultimately resulted in his capture and subsequent rehabilitation under Cecil Stedman and the Global Defense Agency. After confronting the consequences of his actions, Benjamin began attempting to redeem himself and became a member of both the G.D.A. and the Guardians of the Globe.
